15102.name: Hut Of Kigrint

south.description: To the south lies The Sandy Path.

15102.description:
Kigrint's hut is a single low room of driftwood planks and tarred
sailcloth, hung all over with knotted nets and strings of dried sprats.
The floor is packed sand scattered with fish bones and shell cups, and a
clay lamp burns with a smoky, oily flame. Sleeping mats lie rolled
against the curved wall, and the whole place smells of brine and old
smoke. The only door opens south onto the Sandy Path, letting in a thin
stripe of salt air.

15103.name: Kyor'Glt Bakery

south.description: To the south lies The Worn Path.

15103.description:
A squat clay oven fills one end of the bakery, its mouth glowing orange
and breathing out heat. Flat loaves of seaweed bread and sticky buns of
crushed nuts cool on racks along the sooty walls, and flour dusts every
plank of the counter. The air is thick and sweet, with a bitter edge of
burnt crust. The only way out is south, back to the Worn Path.

15104.name: The Untravelled Path

north.description: To the north lies Gate To Kyor'Glt.

south.description: To the south lies The Worn Path.

15104.description:
Weeds have crept across this track, and the few footprints in the sand
are old and half blown away. Thorny sea-buckthorn crowds the edges,
heavy with orange berries. Ahead to the north the great bronze gate of
Kyor'Glt stands open now, its blue-green leaves swung back on stiff
hinges so that the dock beyond can be seen. The path leads south to the
Worn Path and the town.

extra_descs.gate bronze:
The bronze leaves are carved with round-eyed fish faces and stand wide
open on their hinges, green with age.

15105.name: The Storage Room

south.description: To the south lies The Brawler's Room.

15105.description:
Crates and barrels crowd the storage room to the rafters, stacked with
salted fish, tallow and coils of tarred rope. Sacks of grey sea-salt
lean against the wall and spill a crust of white onto the floor. A
single slit high up lets in a blade of light, thick with drifting dust.
The only door leads south, back to the Brawler's Room.

15106.name: Deeper In The Seaweed Forest

north.description: To the north lies Deeper In The Seaweed Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Seaweed Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Cloudy Deep.

west.description: To the west lies Deeper In The Seaweed Forest.

15106.description:
The seaweed grows so thick and tall here that it closes over the raft
like a green forest, and you pole blindly through twisting aisles of
kelp. Light falls in soft shafts and the water is warm and heavy. Every
turn seems to lead back to the same tangled place, whichever way the
current tugs. The weed thins east, and a cold pull draws toward the
south.

15107.name: The Seaweed Forest

east.description: To the east lies The Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Ancient Ruins.

west.description: To the west lies Deeper In The Seaweed Forest.

15107.description:
Your raft drifts among thick brown stems of kelp that rise from the
depths and tangle on the surface into floating mats. The swell lifts and
lowers you in slow rhythm, and the creak of the weed is almost like
speech. The beach shows through the stems to the east. The kelp grows
deeper west, and old ruined stones show dim beneath you toward the
south.

15108.name: The Shore

east.description: To the east lies The Sandy Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Seaweed Forest.

west.description: To the west lies The Seaweed Forest.

15108.description:
The beach is a long crescent of grey shingle and dark sand, strewn with
wrack and the bleached ribs of wrecked boats. Gulls scream over a tangle
of kelp that heaves in the shallows, and the surf pounds with a steady
roar. A wooden raft is drawn up on the pebbles. The path leads east to
the Sandy Path, while the water begins south and west among the thick
weed.

15109.name: The Sandy Path

north.description: To the north lies Hut Of Kigrint.

east.description: To the east lies Dirt Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Shore.

15109.description:
Pale sand lies drifted across the path, soft underfoot and speckled with
broken shells. Palms lean overhead, rattling their fronds in the sea
wind, and a line of gutted fish hangs drying between two trunks. A
driftwood hut stands to the north with its door ajar to the weather. The
path runs east toward the Dirt Path and falls away west to the open
Shore, where the surf can be heard hissing on the beach.

15110.name: Dirt Path

east.description: To the east lies The Worn Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Sandy Path.

15110.description:
The sand gives way here to hard-packed brown dirt, rutted by hand carts
and bare, clawed feet. Squat palms thin out, and a rack of split fish
cooks in the sun beside the track, buzzing with flies. Someone has
scratched crude wavy marks into a stump to claim the rack. The path
leads west back toward the Sandy Path and on east to the Worn Path.

15111.name: The Worn Path

north.description: To the north lies Kyor'Glt Bakery.

east.description: To the east lies The Worn Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Goblin Weaponry.

west.description: To the west lies Dirt Path.

15111.description:
The path is trodden into a shallow trench here, polished smooth by years
of traffic. A warm smell of baking bread drifts from a doorway to the
north, mixing with the oily tang of a whetstone from the low building to
the south. Strings of dried fish and bright gull feathers sway from the
eaves. The Worn Path goes on east, and the Dirt Path lies back to the
west.

15112.name: The Worn Path

north.description: To the north lies The Untravelled Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Goblin Tavern.

south.description: To the south lies The Well Worn Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Worn Path.

15112.description:
The path widens into a rough crossing where several ways meet. Loud
voices and the thump of a drum spill from a stout door to the east, and
a row of pegs along a wall is hung with dripping silver fish. A faded
track leads north toward the Untravelled Path, while the way south
becomes the Well Worn Path. To the west the trodden road returns to
another stretch of the Worn Path.

extra_descs.pegs fish:
The pegs are polished by use, each one hung with a gutted fish, and
drips from them have worn a dark patch into the wall planks.

15113.name: The Goblin Tavern

east.description: To the east lies The Brawler's Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Worn Path.

15113.description:
The tavern is a low, smoky room of sticky tables and upturned barrels
for stools, lit by lamps of fish oil that gutter and stink. A long plank
bar runs along one wall, scarred with a hundred knife-carved marks and
slopped with pale seaweed ale. Rough songs and louder arguments seem to
soak into the beams overhead. A stout door leads west to the Worn Path,
and an archway opens east into the Brawler's Room.

15114.name: The Brawler's Room

north.description: To the north lies The Storage Room.

west.description: To the west lies The Goblin Tavern.

15114.description:
Sand has been strewn thick on the floor of this room to soak up spilled
blood and ale, and it is trodden into a dark crust. A ring of rope hangs
slack between four posts at the centre, and the benches around it are
cracked and splintered. Old gouges mark the plank walls at the height of
a goblin's head. The tavern lies back to the west, and a door to the
north leads into a storage room.

15115.name: The Eflykt Hut

south.description: To the south lies A Turn In The Path.

15115.description:
The Eflykt hut is cramped and tidy, its walls lined with shelves of
whelk shells, bundles of herbs and little carved fish. A mat of woven
reeds covers the sand floor, and a battered cooking pot hangs over a
cold fire pit. The light that finds its way in is dim and brown,
filtered through patched sailcloth. The door leads south onto the turn
in the path.

15116.name: The Cloudy Deep

north.description: To the north lies Deeper In The Seaweed Forest.

east.description: To the east lies Ancient Ruins.

south.description: To the south lies Davy Jones' Locker.

west.description: To the west lies The Cloudy Deep.

15116.description:
The water has turned cloudy and green, thick with silt and the fine
white dust of drowned things, and you can see no further than the end of
your raft. The swell is slow and oily, and the weed hangs in the murk
like drowned hair. The current drags to the south toward deeper dark.
North, the kelp grows thicker, and to the east lies a heap of ancient
stone.

15117.name: Ancient Ruins

north.description: To the north lies The Seaweed Forest.

east.description: To the east lies The Seaweed Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Sunken Ship.

west.description: To the west lies The Cloudy Deep.

15117.description:
Ruined arches and half-toppled walls loom out of the green gloom around
your raft, crusted with barnacles and drifting with weed. Broken columns
lie jumbled on the seabed below, and the carved faces on them are worn
blank by the tide. Currents pull gently toward each point of the
compass. Open water lies in every direction: kelp to the north, a
thicker forest of weed to the east, a dark hulk to the south and a murky
deep to the west.

15118.name: The Seaweed Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To Triton's Fortress.

west.description: To the west lies Ancient Ruins.

15118.description:
You drift on a battered raft in dark green water, with great ribbons of
kelp rising on every side like the pillars of a drowned hall. Silt hangs
in the swell and pale fish flicker in and out of the weeds. The beach
lies close to the north. A round door of corroded bronze stands in a
wall of black rock to the south, and the weed thins to ruined stonework
to the west.

15119.name: The Goblin Weaponry

north.description: To the north lies The Worn Path.

15119.description:
Cutlasses, boarding axes and spears fill the racks inside this rough
forge-shop, and the long counter is notched where blades have been
tested. A whetstone wheel stands in the corner, wet and gleaming, with a
pile of sparks scorched into the floor beneath. Everything smells of hot
iron and fish oil. A wide opening leads north to the Worn Path.

15120.name: The Well Worn Path

north.description: To the north lies The Worn Path.

east.description: To the east lies The Littered Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Armory.

15120.description:
The path here has been worn down into a groove, deeper than a boot, by
countless trips from the town to the water. A stone-ringed well stands
to one side, its rope frayed and its bucket hanging from a bent iron
hook. North lies the busy crossing of the Worn Path, and the path goes
on east toward the Littered Path. A heavy door to the south leads into
the Armory.

15121.name: The Littered Path

south.description: To the south lies The Ruined Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Well Worn Path.

15121.description:
Rubbish piles up along both edges of the path: fish heads, cracked pots,
rags stiff with grease and gnawed bones. A cloud of flies rises and
settles with every step. The trodden dirt bends away south toward the
Ruined Path, while the way back west leads to the Well Worn Path. A
single palm survives, its trunk stained with years of thrown slops.

15122.name: The Littered Path

east.description: To the east lies The Muddy Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Trickle Of Water.

15122.description:
Scraps and shells are ground into the mud here, carried down from the
trickle of water nearby. A broken amphora lies half buried, its neck
sticking up like a gravestone. Beetles scuttle through the litter, and a
cracked bucket serves as a sign that someone once tried to tidy up. The
way east leads on to the Muddy Path, and the trickle of water lies to
the south.

15123.name: The Muddy Path

east.description: To the east lies A Turn In The Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Littered Path.

15123.description:
The path has dissolved into a sticky brown mire of mud, studded with
flat stones and rotting planks laid down as stepping places. The air is
heavy with the sour reek of wet earth and seaweed. A pair of palms bend
over the track, their fronds dripping. The way leads west to the
Littered Path and east to a turn in the path.

15124.name: A Turn In The Path

north.description: To the north lies The Eflykt Hut.

east.description: To the east lies The Gafftl Hut.

south.description: To the south lies The Path Narrows.

west.description: To the west lies The Muddy Path.

15124.description:
Four ways meet at a bend in the path, hemmed in by palms and the walls
of two huts. The doors of the northern hut and of the one to the east
are both made of lashed driftwood, painted with crude spirals and fish.
A line of washing, grey with salt, snaps in the breeze. The path narrows
to the south, and the Muddy Path runs back west.

15125.name: The Gafftl Hut

west.description: To the west lies A Turn In The Path.

15125.description:
The Gafftl hut smells of tar and wet wool, with a heap of mended nets in
one corner and a half-built boat rib propped against the wall. A single
stool stands by a table scarred with knife cuts, and an old bronze
cleaver is nailed above the door as a charm. The roof is thatch black
with smoke. The door leads west back onto the turn in the path.

15126.name: Davy Jones' Locker

north.description: To the north lies The Cloudy Deep.

15126.description:
Davy Jones' Locker is the blackest, deepest water in all this sea, where
the raft turns in a slow cold whirl. Silver bubbles rise from the depths
and burst at the surface, and the swell breathes up and down with the
weight of an unseen current. Drowned masts and scraps of rope drift past
in the dark. The only way back is north, through cloudy water.

15127.name: The Sunken Ship

north.description: To the north lies Ancient Ruins.

15127.description:
The black hulk of a sunken ship lies on its side beneath you, its masts
snapped and its rail hung with weed and shells. Your raft rubs the green
timbers of the keel, and the swell laps through a ragged hole in the
hull. A drowned figurehead stares up at the surface with empty eyes. The
water leads north to the ruins.

15128.name: Entrance To Triton's Fortress

north.description: To the north lies The Seaweed Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Waiting Room.

15128.description:
The raft bumps against a towering wall of dark coral and barnacled
stone, its surface carved with the faces of tritons. A great arched door
of pearl-inlaid bronze stands in the wall to the south, ajar above the
waterline. Lamps of cold blue light glow in niches either side. The
water behind you leads north into the weeds.

15129.name: The Armory

north.description: To the north lies The Well Worn Path.

15129.description:
Racks of battered shields, dented helms and boiled-hide jerkins line the
walls of the armory, each one tagged with a knotted cord. A bench in the
middle is heaped with straps, buckles and clinking rings of mail. The
air smells of oil and leather, and the floor is gritty with rust. The
only door leads north onto the Well Worn Path.

15130.name: The Ruined Path

north.description: To the north lies The Littered Path.

east.description: To the east lies A Trickle Of Water.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn In The Path.

15130.description:
Broken walls of old stone stand along the path, the remains of huts
whose roofs fell in long ago. Young palms have rooted in the rubble, and
lizards bask on the tumbled blocks. A path goes north toward the
Littered Path and another winds south to a turn. To the east the faint
sound of dripping water draws the eye to a damp patch of green.

15131.name: A Trickle Of Water

north.description: To the north lies The Littered Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Ruined Path.

15131.description:
A thin rill of fresh water trickles from a crack in a mossy boulder and
spreads across the path in a bright, shallow fan. Ferns and green slime
cling to the stones, a welcome softness in this dry place. The mud is
stamped with the prints of many feet that come here to fill jars. The
path leads north toward another stretch of the Littered Path, and west
to the Ruined Path.

15132.name: The Path Narrows

north.description: To the north lies A Turn In The Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Forest.

15132.description:
The path squeezes tight here between a wall of rock and a thicket of
palms. Roots break the ground and tangle the way, and the sea wind that
has followed the track so far dies away. North lies the bend in the path
with its two huts. Ahead to the south the trees rise taller and darker,
and the track leads on into the forest.

15133.name: The Noble's Court

east.description: To the east lies The Waiting Room.

15133.description:
You float in the flooded Noble's Court, a ring of drowned colonnades
whose pillars are furred with weed and carved with stately sea-folk.
Shafts of dim blue light fall through gaps in the ceiling and shiver on
the water. A bell somewhere deep sounds slow and mournful. The only way
on is east, to the dry hall.

15134.name: The Waiting Room

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To Triton's Fortress.

south.description: To the south lies The Throne Room Of The Sea King.

west.description: To the west lies The Noble's Court.

15134.description:
The Waiting Room is a dry vaulted hall deep in the fortress, with walls
of polished coral and a floor of mother-of-pearl that shimmers in the
dim blue light. Benches of whalebone line the sides, carved with waves
and shells. The air is cool and tastes of salt. A great door of carved
shell opens south on the throne room, an archway of water leads west
into a flooded court, and the entrance lies north.

15135.name: Chief Gralkt's Hut

east.description: To the east lies The Palm Covered Path.

15135.description:
Chief Gralkt's hut is the largest in the town, a long room of timber and
thatch hung with trophies from the sea: harpoons, ships' lanterns,
painted figureheads and a great jawbone over the door. A heap of
cushions made of sailcloth is laid before a low table crowded with maps.
Smoke from a whale-oil lamp makes the ceiling shine. The door leads east
to the Palm Covered Path.

extra_descs.jawbone:
The jawbone belongs to some huge sea beast, bleached white, and the
teeth in it are the length of a hand.

15136.name: The Palm Covered Path

east.description: To the east lies The Palm Covered Path.

west.description: To the west lies Chief Gralkt's Hut.

15136.description:
The sand is smooth here, swept clean by broom and by wind, and the palms
stand in a tidy row on each side. Flags of bright cloth snap from poles,
and a ring of whitewashed stones marks the approach to a large hut. A
broad door to the west is carved with a crude sunburst. The path runs
east back through the palms.

15137.name: The Palm Covered Path

east.description: To the east lies A Turn In The Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Palm Covered Path.

15137.description:
Palms of every height crowd the path here, their fronds knotting into a
swaying green tunnel. Coconuts lie among the leaves and fibrous husks
are heaped up in drifts. A string of shells hangs from a branch and
chimes in the breeze. The trodden sand leads east to the turn in the
path and west to the next stretch of palms.

15138.name: A Turn In The Path

north.description: To the north lies The Ruined Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Palm Covered Path.

15138.description:
The path swings round a stand of fat palms, and the sand underfoot turns
pale and fine again. A cool breeze brings the smell of the sea and of
tar from somewhere ahead. Crabs have left a lacework of tiny tracks
across the dune. The path leads north toward the Ruined Path and west
under a canopy of palm fronds.

15139.name: The Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Path Narrows.

south.description: To the south lies The Dim Forest.

15139.description:
Tall trees press close on either side, their trunks furred with moss and
their crowns tangled overhead into a green roof. A thin trail of trodden
leaf mould winds on between the roots. Birds call somewhere high up, and
the air smells of damp bark. North the trail leads back toward the Path
Narrows, and south it sinks into a dimmer wood.

15140.name: The Throne Room Of The Sea King

north.description: To the north lies The Waiting Room.

15140.description:
The throne room of the Sea King is a vast domed chamber of pearl and
blue glass, in which pale light ripples across the walls like water. A
throne of twisted coral stands upon a dais of nacre, flanked by tall
columns wound with golden chains. Scattered shells and pearls glitter in
the gloom. The only way out is the door north.

15141.name: The Dim Forest

north.description: To the north lies The Forest.

south.description: To the south lies The Murky Woods.

15141.description:
Little light reaches the ground in this part of the forest. Thick
creepers hang from the boughs like slack ropes, and pale fungus grows in
rings around the rotting stumps. The trail is hard to follow and often
vanishes under drifts of dead leaves. It leads north toward the Forest
and south to the Murky Woods.

15142.name: The Apprentice Chambers

east.description: To the east lies A Storage Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark Hallway.

15142.description:
This chamber has the cramped look of a student's quarters, with straw
pallets along the wall and a table piled with cracked slates and
dripping candle stubs. Scraps of coloured chalk lie scattered, and half-
erased circles are scratched into the floor. A faint scorched smell
hangs in the air. A narrow door in the east wall leads to a storage
room, and the hall lies to the south.

15143.name: A Storage Room

west.description: To the west lies The Apprentice Chambers.

15143.description:
Shelves of dusty jars and bundles of dried roots line the walls of this
closet, labelled in a crabbed, childish hand. A cracked mortar sits in
one corner next to a broom with half its bristles gone. The air is stale
and tastes of old herbs. The only way out is west, back to the
Apprentice Chambers.

15144.name: A Secret Passageway

east.description: To the east lies Morvoct's Inner Sanctum.

south.description: To the south lies A Secret Passageway.

15144.description:
A last stretch of narrow passage ends in a low arch, beyond which the
smell of incense and old blood is strong. The stone here is smoother and
carefully fitted, as if made for someone's pride. A thin line of
torchlight glimmers to the east. The tunnel leads back south.

15145.name: Morvoct's Inner Sanctum

west.description: To the west lies A Secret Passageway.

15145.description:
Morvoct's Inner Sanctum is a small round chamber with a domed roof, hung
with black cloth and lit by a ring of fat red candles. In the centre
stands a stone chair carved with leering faces, with a pile of stolen
furs heaped at its foot. Gold coins and rusted crowns are pushed into
the corners as if forgotten. The only way out is the passage west.

15146.name: A Rock Plateau

east.description: To the east lies A Clearing.

south.description: To the south lies The Porch.

15146.description:
The ground here climbs to a bare plateau of grey rock, scoured by wind
and dotted with tufts of salt grass. A great view opens over the green
tops of the forest and out to the far glitter of the sea. The rock is
cracked and splintered, and gulls wheel high above it. A path leads east
down to a clearing, and a rough stair of stone leads south to a porch.

15147.name: A Clearing

east.description: To the east lies A Hollow.

west.description: To the west lies A Rock Plateau.

15147.description:
A grassy clearing opens in the scrub, bright with sun and humming with
bees. A ring of white stones, half sunk in the turf, marks where
something once stood. Gnats drift in clouds above the long grass. The
clearing runs east to a hollow and west to a rocky height.

15148.name: A Hollow

south.description: To the south lies A Rock Pile.

west.description: To the west lies A Clearing.

15148.description:
The ground here dips into a hollow, a round bowl in the hillside lined
with soft moss and ringed by gnarled thorn bushes. The air is still and
warm, sheltered from every wind. An old fire pit lies cold near the
middle, its stones black. A path leads south to the rock pile and west
into a clearing.

15149.name: The Murky Woods

north.description: To the north lies The Dim Forest.

east.description: To the east lies A Few Leafless Trees.

south.description: To the south lies The Dank Woods.

15149.description:
Grey, sour-smelling mud lies between the trunks here, and thin mist
clings to the knees of the trees. The wood is quiet except for the slow
drip of water from the branches. Trails run in three directions: north
back toward the Dim Forest, east to a few bare trees, and south into the
Dank Woods. A rotted signpost leans at the crossing, its lettering long
since washed away.

15150.name: A Few Leafless Trees

east.description: To the east lies The Guarded Hall.

west.description: To the west lies The Murky Woods.

15150.description:
A handful of dead trees stand in a clearing, bone-white and stripped of
bark, their bare branches clawing at the sky. Nothing else grows on the
hard-packed earth. West, the murky woods close in again. To the east a
squat fortress of rough black stone fills the way, with a heavy door set
in its face and a rusted lantern hanging above it.

15151.name: The Guarded Hall

east.description: To the east lies The Dark Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Guard Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Few Leafless Trees.

15151.description:
The Guarded Hall is a broad stone chamber with a smoke-blackened ceiling
and a floor of worn flags. Torches burn in iron brackets and throw
wavering shadows over racks of spears and a rough table scattered with
dice. The door to the west leads out to the dead trees. A dark hallway
runs east, and a doorway to the south opens on the guard room.

15152.name: The Dark Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Apprentice Chambers.

south.description: To the south lies Darker Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Guarded Hall.

15152.description:
The hallway is narrow and gloomy, its walls sweating with damp and lit
only by a single guttering torch. The flags underfoot are worn into
shallow dips, and the air smells of cold ash. Back west the light of the
Guarded Hall can be seen. The hallway goes north to the Apprentice
Chambers and south into a still darker passage.

15153.name: The Room Of Mists

up.description: To the up lies The Great Hall.

15153.description:
A cold white mist fills this round chamber, rising from cracks in the
floor and curling around your knees. The stone walls drip, and sound is
swallowed by the fog so that even breathing seems far away. Faint
patterns of light drift in the vapour as if something moved just beyond
sight. The ladder is the only way out, leading up.

15154.name: A Secret Passageway

east.description: To the east lies A Secret Passageway.

south.description: To the south lies Room Of Dark Shadows.

15154.description:
A secret way, scarcely wider than a barrel, twists through the thickness
of the wall here. Cobwebs and grit cling to the roughly chiselled stone,
and the smell of dust is strong. The tunnel bends away east along a
faintly sloping floor. The way south opens back into a shadowy room.

15155.name: A Secret Passageway

north.description: To the north lies A Secret Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies A Secret Passageway.

15155.description:
The tunnel zigzags between close walls, scratched with tally marks and
half-faded runes. Water drips with a slow, steady beat from somewhere
overhead, and the air is cold and tastes of rust. The passage runs north
to a further stretch and west to the bend behind you. Shallow footprints
are pressed into the grey dust.

15156.name: The Great Hall

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of The Conquered.

down.description: To the down lies The Room Of Mists.

15156.description:
The Great Hall rises high into shadow, its beams black with centuries of
smoke. A long table of single-plank oak runs the whole length of the
floor, scored by knives and stained with spilled drink. Tall chairs of
whalebone stand at the head, facing a hearth big enough to roast an ox.
The door lies south, and a ladder of rusted iron climbs down through a
hole in the floor.

15157.name: Animal Pens

east.description: To the east lies The Cyclop's Den.

south.description: To the south lies The Far Corner.

15157.description:
Rough pens of lashed timber and thorn branches fill this end of the den,
their gates tied shut with knotted hide. Trampled dung and chewed straw
cover the floor, and the sharp smell of beasts is overpowering. Scratch
marks and a few tufts of coarse hair cling to the posts. The big den
lies east, and a gap in the fence leads south to a dim corner.

15158.name: The Cyclop's Den

east.description: To the east lies The Porch.

south.description: To the south lies Fireside.

west.description: To the west lies Animal Pens.

15158.description:
The den is a huge round chamber hacked out of the living rock, with a
ceiling lost in smoke. A bed of heaped hides lies against one wall, big
enough for three goblins to sleep in, and a gnawed ox-leg is propped
beside it. A giant stool and table stand to the south near the glow of a
fire, and wooden pens occupy the west. The door east leads to the porch.

15159.name: The Porch

north.description: To the north lies A Rock Plateau.

west.description: To the west lies The Cyclop's Den.

15159.description:
A porch of huge rough-cut stones juts from the rock face, roofed by an
overhanging ledge that keeps off the weather. Bones of large animals are
piled neatly along its edge, and a pole stands by the entrance hung with
scraps of pelt. The stone beneath is worn smooth by one heavy tread. A
path leads north up to the plateau, and a massive door to the west opens
into a den.

15160.name: A Rock Pile

north.description: To the north lies A Hollow.

east.description: To the east lies A Waterfall.

south.description: To the south lies A Steep Cliff.

15160.description:
Great slabs of fallen stone lie heaped in a tumbled pile, as if some
mountain had shrugged them off. Small ferns grow in the gaps, and the
rocks are slick underfoot. The roar of the falls lies to the east. A
narrow trail climbs north to a hollow, and a steeper way drops south
toward a cliff.

15161.name: A Waterfall

east.description: To the east lies The Dank Woods.

west.description: To the west lies A Rock Pile.

15161.description:
A thin white waterfall tumbles down a black rock face into a pool that
foams and steams in the cool air. Spray drifts across the path and soaks
everything with a cold dew. Slick stones form a rough ford at the edge.
The trail leads east back into the Dank Woods and climbs west to a heap
of broken rock.

15162.name: The Dank Woods

north.description: To the north lies The Murky Woods.

west.description: To the west lies A Waterfall.

15162.description:
The woods are heavy here, sagging with wet and reeking of rotted leaves.
Fat toadstools crowd the trunks, and the ground gives under each
footstep. Somewhere to the west is the steady roar of falling water. A
trail leads north to the Murky Woods and west toward the sound of the
water.

15163.name: Guard Room

north.description: To the north lies The Guarded Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Prison.

15163.description:
A small stone room, hung with weapons and stinking of damp leather and
old sweat. A table with a rack of cudgels and a pot of cold broth stands
in the middle, and sleeping pallets lie along the wall. A ring of keys
dangles from a nail by the door. The hall lies north, and a heavy door,
banded in iron, leads south.

15164.name: Darker Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Dark Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Dark Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Apprentice Workshop.

15164.description:
Here the hallway grows darker still, and the torches have been left to
burn down to cold black stubs in their brackets. The floor is gritty
with sand and the ceiling is lost in shadow. A draught carries the smell
of oil and singed hair. The passage goes north to the Dark Hallway,
turns east along another dark stretch, and drops south into a workshop.

15165.name: Dark Hallway

south.description: To the south lies Dark Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Darker Hallway.

15165.description:
The passage bends here, the walls close enough to brush with both
elbows. Soot streaks the stone above every bracket, though no torch
burns in them now. Water has seeped through the ceiling and left a pale
crust of salt on the floor. A dark hallway runs back west, and the
passage turns south toward a wider space.

15166.name: Room Of Dark Shadows

north.description: To the north lies A Secret Passageway.

east.description: To the east lies Herb Garden.

15166.description:
Deep shadow pools in every corner of this chamber, as thick as spilled
ink, and the single weak lamp seems to make it darker rather than
brighter. The walls are bare and cold, and the floor is scattered with
old feathers and dust. A whisper of cold air stirs from a gap in the
stonework to the north. A passage leads east back toward the herb
garden.

15167.name: Herb Garden

east.description: To the east lies Hall Of The Conquered.

west.description: To the west lies Room Of Dark Shadows.

15167.description:
Rows of herbs grow in raised troughs of stone, tended under a lattice of
glowing fungus that lights the room with a pale green gleam. Bitter
wormwood, sea-kale and pungent garlic mix their scents in the damp air.
The soil is black and freshly turned, and a bone-handled trowel is stuck
upright in it. The hall lies east, and a dark doorway opens west.

15168.name: Hall Of The Conquered

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of The Conquered.

west.description: To the west lies Herb Garden.

15168.description:
The northern end of the hall is a broad flagged floor, scuffed bright by
many marching feet. Pillars stand in pairs, and between them hang rows
of grey skulls strung on cord that click softly in the draught. A great
oak door in the north wall is studded with bronze nails. To the west an
arch gives onto a green and fragrant room, and the hall runs back south.

15169.name: The Far Corner

north.description: To the north lies Animal Pens.

east.description: To the east lies Fireside.

15169.description:
In the dimmest corner of the den, shadows pool around heaps of rubbish,
discarded bones and the ragged leftovers of meals. A cracked clay jar
the size of a barrel holds rainwater, scummed green on top. The smell is
rank, a mix of old fat and wet fur. Light from the fire glows to the
east, and the animal pens lie north.

15170.name: Fireside

north.description: To the north lies The Cyclop's Den.

west.description: To the west lies The Far Corner.

15170.description:
A great fire burns in a ring of boulders here, filling the den with a
ruddy glow and a thick smell of roasting meat. Skins are pegged to the
rock around it to dry, and a huge iron pot hangs from a beam of black
timber. The floor is warm and covered in ash. The den lies north, and a
dim corner lies to the west.

15171.name: A Steep Cliff

north.description: To the north lies A Rock Pile.

south.description: To the south lies Entering The Harpy's Nest.

15171.description:
The trail drops onto a narrow ledge along a steep cliff of crumbling
yellow stone. Far below, the sea heaves and bursts white against rocks,
and the wind tugs hard at your clothes. Droppings streak the stone and
long grey feathers cling in the cracks. A rough track leads north to a
pile of rock, while the ledge winds south around the face toward a nest.

15172.name: Prison

north.description: To the north lies Guard Room.

15172.description:
The prison is a low cellar divided by rusty bars into narrow cells.
Straw rots in the corners, and iron rings are bolted to the walls at the
height of a wrist. A pitiful scratch of tally marks climbs one wall. The
air is cold and damp, and water drips from a crack in the ceiling. The
only way out is north, through the guard room.

15173.name: Apprentice Workshop

north.description: To the north lies Darker Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Dark Hallway.

15173.description:
Benches and workbenches fill this workshop, heaped with blackened tongs,
cracked crucibles and bits of scrap metal. A forge of rough brick squats
against one wall, ash heaped about its grate and a pair of leather
bellows dangling beside it. The floor is gritty with filings and half-
melted wax. A hallway leads north, and a narrow opening leads east to
another passage.

15174.name: Dark Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Dark Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Dragon's Domain.

west.description: To the west lies Apprentice Workshop.

15174.description:
A draught whines along this stretch of hallway, stirring cobwebs that
hang in long grey ropes from the roof. The flagstones are cracked and
scored with the marks of dragged crates. A sharp, hot smell like a forge
comes from somewhere ahead. The hall runs north to a bend, west to the
Apprentice Workshop, and south into a larger chamber.

15175.name: Torture Room

east.description: To the east lies Caged Animal Room.

15175.description:
A cold chamber of black stone, stained dark in patterns beneath the rack
and the wheel. Hooks and iron tongs hang in rows from the walls, and
manacles hang from a ring in the ceiling. Old rust-brown splashes cover
the floor around a drain. The only way out is east, through the room of
cages.

15176.name: Caged Animal Room

east.description: To the east lies Hall Of The Conquered.

west.description: To the west lies Torture Room.

15176.description:
Iron cages line the walls of this room, their bars bent and their floors
thick with straw and bones. Chains hang from rings in the stone, and a
heavy musk of animals and rot hangs in the air. Claw marks are cut deep
into the doorframe. The hall lies east, and a low door in the opposite
wall leads on west.

15177.name: Hall Of The Conquered

north.description: To the north lies Hall Of The Conquered.

south.description: To the south lies Hall Of The Conquered.

west.description: To the west lies Caged Animal Room.

15177.description:
Trophies cover the walls of this section of the hall: dented helms,
notched swords and shields pierced by spears, each with a scrap of cloth
nailed beneath as a tally of the beaten. A broad trough of embers glows
down the middle, giving the pillars a sullen red cast. Hall continues
both north and south of here. A heavy door in the west wall is barred
with an iron rod and leads to a place of cages.

extra_descs.trophies helms shields:
Each trophy carries a scrap of cloth in a different colour, the livery
of some company or town that learned too late what Morvoct's goblins can
do.

15178.name: The Man Cage

east.description: To the east lies Hallway.

15178.description:
A heavy cage of lashed bone and driftwood stands in this alcove, too
small to stand in, with a floor smeared with filth and fish scales.
Gnawed leg-bones are heaped in a corner, and the bars are scratched with
tally marks. A cold draught blows through the gaps. The only way out is
east, back to the hallway.

15179.name: Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Landing Perch.

south.description: To the south lies Grub Kitchen.

west.description: To the west lies The Man Cage.

15179.description:
This hallway is hacked into the cliff, its walls rough and streaked with
smoke and bird lime. A bundle of reeds burns in a holder, sputtering and
sending uneven light along the ceiling. Bones and feathers crunch
underfoot. The perch lies east in the wind, a smell of cooking comes
from a doorway south, and a barred opening to the west leads to a cage.

15180.name: The Landing Perch

east.description: To the east lies Entering The Harpy's Nest.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway.

15180.description:
A broad shelf of rock juts out over the drop like a landing stage,
scraped bare and slimed with white droppings. Great curved claw-marks
gouge the stone near the lip. The wind is fierce and smells of salt and
rot, and tufts of feather skitter across the floor. The ledge leads east
back to the nest's entrance, and a dark opening in the cliff leads west
into a hallway.

15181.name: Entering The Harpy's Nest

north.description: To the north lies A Steep Cliff.

west.description: To the west lies The Landing Perch.

15181.description:
The cliff ledge widens here into a rough platform littered with sticks,
bones and shreds of cloth. Shrill cries echo off the rock, and the
stench of old fish and droppings stings the nose. The sea is a long way
below, and gulls ride the updraughts. A path runs north back along the
ledge, and a gap in the cliff leads west toward a perch.

15182.name: Dragon's Domain

north.description: To the north lies Dark Hallway.

up.description: To the up lies Hall Of The Conquered.

15182.description:
The walls of this chamber are carved with the coils of a great scaled
beast, worked in black stone that glints like wet slate. A hoard bowl of
beaten bronze, long since emptied, stands in the middle of the floor.
The air is warm and carries an old scent of smoke and cinders. A passage
leads north, and a narrow stair of black steps winds up into the dark.

extra_descs.bowl hoard:
The bronze bowl is wide enough to bathe in, dented and blackened, and
the floor around it is scorched in a perfect ring.

15183.name: Hall Of The Conquered

north.description: To the north lies Hall Of The Conquered.

down.description: To the down lies Dragon's Domain.

15183.description:
The stair ends in a long hall of rough-hewn stone, whose roof is held up
by pillars carved into the shapes of kneeling prisoners. Banners of
tattered hide hang between them, painted with the crude red sign of
Morvoct. Smoke from a trough of burning fat clings under the ceiling and
stings the eyes. The hall stretches north, and the stair winds down
behind you.

15184.name: Grub Kitchen

north.description: To the north lies Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Dining Hall.

15184.description:
The kitchen is a ragged cave of smoke-blackened stone, with a stone slab
for a table and a firepit crowded with iron pots. Hooks hang from the
ceiling, and a few dried scraps of meat dangle from them. The floor is
greasy and spattered with old stains. The hallway lies north, and the
din of a dining hall comes through an arch to the east.

15185.name: Dining Hall

east.description: To the east lies Piles Of Straw.

west.description: To the west lies Grub Kitchen.

15185.description:
The dining hall is a long rough chamber crowded with benches knocked
together from driftwood and wrecked ship's timber. Bone-white plates and
cups lie scattered over a table stained with years of spills. A stale
reek of fish, wine and old bones fills the air. The kitchen lies to the
west, and a floor of piled straw begins to the east.

15186.name: Piles Of Straw

west.description: To the west lies Dining Hall.

up.description: To the up lies The Harpy Queen's Nest.

15186.description:
Mounds of dry straw cover the floor, matted down into dozens of hollows
where sleepers have curled. Feathers, bones and bright stolen trinkets
are pressed into the straw, and the air is thick with dust that tickles
the throat. A crude ladder of lashed branches climbs to a higher ledge.
The dining hall lies west and the nest of the queen rises up above.

15187.name: The Harpy Queen's Nest

down.description: To the down lies Piles Of Straw.

15187.description:
The queen's nest is a huge bowl of woven branches, bones and sailcloth,
perched on a ledge at the top of the cliff. The wind howls through the
weave, and a layer of soft grey down covers the floor. Shiny things are
scattered around the rim: buckles, coins, a cracked mirror, and a
shattered ship's bell. The only way back is down the ladder.

extra_descs.bell ship's:
The bronze bell is split down one side and green with age. A ship's name
is still faintly legible around its rim, but the rest has long since
worn away.

649100.name: goblin townsgoblin townsman
649100.long_desc: A salt-stained goblin shuffles past, humming a rough song and carrying a basket of fish.
649100.description:
This goblin has a leathery green hide, long drooping ears and a wide,
toothy grin. His clothes are patched sailcloth, and he smells strongly
of tar and herring.

649101.name: goblin warrior guard
649101.long_desc: A scarred goblin warrior stands here with a cutlass in his fist, eyeing you for trouble.
649101.description:
A broad-shouldered goblin in boiled-hide armour, his green face crossed
with old scars. His eyes are small and sly, and he fingers the hilt of
his blade as though itching for a quarrel.

649102.name: giant crab
649102.long_desc: A giant crab clacks its pincers at you from a mat of floating kelp.
649102.description:
Its shell is as wide as a shield, mottled green and brown and crusted
with barnacles. Two huge pincers snap in the water, and its stalked eyes
follow every movement.

649103.name: harpy matron
649103.long_desc: A fierce harpy matron perches here with her talons flexed and her feathers bristling.
649103.description:
The harpy has the body of a vulture and the wrinkled, furious face of an
old woman. Her talons are curved like sickles, and her shriek could
crack stone.

649104.name: merman guard triton
649104.long_desc: A merman guard in a coral breastplate floats here, his trident held steady.
649104.description:
His upper body is armoured in scales of polished shell, and his lower
body is a thick silvery fish tail. He holds a barbed trident as long as
a boat-hook and watches you with cold, round eyes.

649105.name: brogg cyclops giant one-eyed
649105.long_desc: Brogg Oneye, the cyclops, squats here, his single great eye glaring from beneath a ridge of brow.
649105.description:
A towering giant with a rough grey hide and one huge yellow eye in the
middle of his forehead. He grips a club made from a ship's mast, scarred
and spiked with nails.

649106.name: morvoct warlord goblin
649106.long_desc: Morvoct, the goblin warlord, stands among his trophies, a huge axe resting on his shoulder.
649106.description:
Morvoct is the biggest goblin you have ever seen, half again as tall as
the rest, with a hide the colour of old moss and eyes like polished
amber. He is draped in furs and chains of stolen gold, and the crown on
his brow is a dented helm of bronze.

749100.name: cutlass chipped goblin
749100.room_desc: A chipped goblin cutlass lies here.
749100.description: A short curved blade of cheap iron, nicked along its edge and bound at the hilt with fishing line. It is crude, but it has seen plenty of fights.

749101.name: buckler crab shell
749101.room_desc: A crab-shell buckler has been left here.
749101.description: The domed carapace of a giant crab, strapped with leather and polished to a dull gleam. It is light, tough and smells faintly of the sea.

749102.name: pearl milk white
749102.description: A perfect pearl the size of a plum, glowing with a soft inner light. Merchants in Port Halyon would pay a fortune for it.

749103.name: maul cyclops mast club
749103.room_desc: A massive club made from a ship's mast lies here.
749103.description: A great maul carved from a broken mast and studded with iron nails. It is heavy enough to stagger anyone not built like a giant.

749104.name: crown helm bronze warlord
749104.short_desc: the dented bronze crown of Morvoct
749104.room_desc: A dented bronze crown lies here.
749104.description: A battered bronze helm worn as a crown, set with chips of blue glass and pearls prised from the wrecks of a hundred ships. A lingering scent of brine clings to it.
